allow: Shell(./scripts/run-with-ipv4.sh pnpm exec dotenv -e .env.local -- sh -c 'pnpm exec prisma migrate diff --from-url "$DATABASE_URL" --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script' > /tmp/diff.sql 2>/tmp/diff.err; echo "exit=$?"; head -5 /tmp/diff.err; wc -l /tmp/diff.sql)

Shell(TS=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S); DIR="prisma/migrations/${TS}_add_organiser_and_checkin"; mkdir -p "$DIR"; printf '%s\n' \ '-- CreateEnum' \ 'CREATE TYPE "CheckInStatus" AS ENUM ('"'"'NOT_CHECKED_IN'"'"', '"'"'CHECKED_IN'"'"');' \ '' \ '-- CreateEnum' \ 'CREATE TYPE "OrganiserRole" AS ENUM ('"'"'ENTRY_SCANNER'"'"', '"'"'ADMIN'"'"');' \ '' \ '-- AlterTable' \ 'ALTER TABLE "bookings" ADD COLUMN "check_in_status" "CheckInStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT '"'"'NOT_CHECKED_IN'"'"',' \ 'ADD COLUMN "checked_in_at" TIMESTAMP(3),' \ 'ADD COLUMN "checked_in_by" TEXT,' \ 'ADD COLUMN "checked_in_by_id" TEXT;' \ '' \ '-- CreateTable' \ 'CREATE TABLE "organisers" (' \ ' "id" TEXT NOT NULL,' \ ' "name" TEXT NOT NULL,' \ ' "login_id" TEXT NOT NULL,' \ ' "credential_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,' \ ' "role" "OrganiserRole" NOT NULL DEFAULT '"'"'ENTRY_SCANNER'"'"',' \ ' "gate_id" TEXT NOT NULL,' \ ' "active" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,' \ ' "failed_login_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,' \ ' "locked_until" TIMESTAMP(3),' \ ' "created_at" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,' \ ' "updated_at" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,' \ ' "last_login_at" TIMESTAMP(3),' \ '' \ ' CONSTRAINT "organisers_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")' \ ');' \ '' \ '-- CreateIndex' \ 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "organisers_login_id_key" ON "organisers"("login_id");' \ > "$DIR/migration.sql"; echo "created $DIR"; cat "$DIR/migration.sql")

Shell(set -e QRSEC=$(openssl rand -hex 32) ORGSEC=$(openssl rand -hex 32) cat >> .env.local <<EOF # ===== Organiser entry / check-in (added for QR entry feature) ===== BOOKING_OPEN_AT="2026-01-01T00:00:00+05:30" BOOKING_CLOSE_AT="2026-10-16T23:00:00+05:30" ENTRY_QR_SECRET="${QRSEC}" ORGANISER_SESSION_SECRET="${ORGSEC}" ORGANISER_GATE_IDS= EOF unset QRSEC ORGSEC for k in BOOKING_OPEN_AT BOOKING_CLOSE_AT ENTRY_QR_SECRET ORGANISER_SESSION_SECRET ORGANISER_GATE_IDS; do grep -q "^$k=" .env.local && echo "$k: PRESENT" || echo "$k: MISSING"; done echo "=== length check (values not shown) ==="; awk -F= '/^(ENTRY_QR_SECRET|ORGANISER_SESSION_SECRET)=/{gsub(/"/,"",$2); print $1 " length=" length($2)}' .env.local git check-ignore -v .env.local)
